question: The Ankeleshwar region of Gujarat is famous for which energy resource from following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Petroleum**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ankleshwar region** in Gujarat is one of India's largest **petroleum-producing** areas.
 
• It is** well-known for its oil fields**, and crude oil extraction has been a significant industry in the region for decades.
 
• The **Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) has major operations in the Ankleshwar oil field.**
 
• Ankleshwar is **located in the Bharuch district of Gujarat, India**.
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru called the Ankleshwar oil field the "fountain of prosperity".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Coal**:

 
 
• Coal is a fossil fuel formed from the remains of ancient plant matter that has been subjected to heat and pressure over millions of years.
 
• **Major Coal Regions in India**: India has abundant coal reserves, particularly in the states of **Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, West Bengal**, and **Madhya Pradesh**. 
 
 
 
• **Uranium**
 
 
• **​**Uranium is a radioactive metal used primarily as fuel for nuclear power plants to generate electricity.
 
• It undergoes nuclear fission, where its atoms split to release energy.
 
• Uranium is the key element used in nuclear reactors and weapons. In reactors, it produces heat that drives turbines to generate electricity.
 
• Uranium deposits are mainly found in **Jharkhand** (Jaduguda Mines), **Andhra Pradesh**, and **Meghalaya**.
 
 
 
• **Thorium**:
 
 
• Thorium is another radioactive element and is considered a potential future fuel for nuclear reactors
 
• India has one of the largest thorium reserves in the world, primarily found in **Kerala** and along the **Monazite-rich sands of the coastal regions**
